This document will show all the figures and tables for the exploratory analysis done in the report.

# Comparing median rent and new bonds lodged

This will compare median rent and new bonds lodged for all of VIC and NSW across:

1.  All properties
2.  1 bedroom
3.  2 bedroom
4.  3 bedroom
5.  4 bedroom

```{r}
state_plots <- plot_rent_and_new_bonds("Data/Final Data/No Controls/State", treated = c("VIC"), controls = c("NSW", "QLD", "SA"), period = "quarter")

purrr::iwalk(state_plots, function(plot, name) {
  file_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", name)

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path("Exhibits/State Plots/Quarterly", paste0(file_name, " Quarterly.png")),
    plot = plot,
    width = 10,
    height = 12,
    dpi = 300
  )
})
```

```{r}
state_plots <- plot_rent_and_new_bonds("Data/Final Data/No Controls/State", treated = c("VIC"), controls = c("NSW", "QLD", "SA"), period = "half")
```

# Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
stats <- c("mean", "sd", "median", "min", "max")

tables <- purrr::map(c("mean", "sd", "median", "min", "max"),
                     \(s) build_summary_stat_table(
                       non_control_folder = "Data/Final Data/No Controls/LGA",
                       control_folder     = "Data/Final Data/With Controls/LGA",
                       stat               = s
                     ))
```
